consumer_proofs.note: A notebook cell whose cross-cell index is still building reuses the partial-index narrowing: completion is labeled pending and routes to wait-for-index.
A generated file reuses the generated-artifact narrowing: completion is read-only and routes to open-generator-source.
A captured request / response artifact reuses the captured-evidence narrowing: editing completion is unavailable and routes to inspect-only.
A fenced docs-code block reuses the projection narrowing: completion is read-only and routes to edit-the-underlying-source.
A protected config reuses the restricted-mode narrowing: completion is read-only and routes to request-approval.

invariants.statement: Each claimed constrained-file state resolves exactly one narrowing cell per assist channel.
Every channel narrowed below full fidelity carries a non-empty disabled-state diagnostic, so the reason is never silently hidden.
Every cell that blocks apply offers a concrete next-safe-action route with a command.
No apply-capable channel is blocked or unavailable without marking apply blocked and disclosing why.
On the large-file state every semantic and apply-capable channel is suppressed or blocked, never full fidelity, and discloses it.
On the partial-index state every semantic channel narrows to a labeled pending state, never silently full fidelity.
On generated and managed states every apply-capable channel blocks apply and routes to open-generator-source or regenerate-from-source.
On the restricted state every apply-capable channel blocks apply and routes to request-approval.
On the captured-evidence state every apply-capable channel is unavailable and routes to inspect-only, while hover and peek still read.
On read-only and projection states hover and peek stay full fidelity while apply-capable channels block apply with a duplicate or edit-source route.
Editing-truth decorations stay full fidelity on every state except large-file, where they narrow to a labeled fallback rather than being dropped.
Every degraded-provider case narrows below full fidelity, is source-labeled, discloses its reason, and offers a route.
Every profile whose provider posture is degraded narrows at least one assist channel.
Every consumer surface reuses a constrained-file state and a catalogued degrade class instead of a local special case, and its asserted narrowing matches the resolved model.
The notebook, generated, request-artifact, docs-code, and protected surfaces each prove the shared constrained-assist vocabulary.
Every constrained-state profile carries a non-empty screen-reader summary.

summary: Constrained-assist model frozen: 8 constrained-file states each resolve a per-channel narrowing over 9 assist channels, plus 3 degraded-provider cases and 5 consumer-surface proofs. Every narrowed channel discloses an inspectable reason and stays keyboard-reachable; every blocked apply offers a next-safe-action route (open generator source, regenerate, duplicate, request approval, edit source, wait for index, open in full editor, reconnect provider, or inspect-only); editing-truth decorations stay full fidelity except in large-file mode; and notebook, generated, request-artifact, docs-code, and protected surfaces reuse the shared vocabulary. All 17 invariants hold.
